title: Transactions, locks, and concurrency
subtitle: Prove what happens when retries, users, and workers race.
goal: Reason about two requests happening at the same time
intro: An async function can run correctly alone and still violate a business rule when another worker races it.
terms: A group of database changes committed together
An expected revision checked during update
flow: Other caller reads the completed result
case: Two browsers confirm the same prepared request.
Only one authoritative request should be created.
An application-only check can be invalid by the time it writes.
